About

The Apex Assembly Cup is a tournament hosted by soothxng and Vlyra, players for Cynosure. It is a versus type tournament where one player or one team will compete individually against another player or team respectively. Tournament organization was aided by Zilka, a member of Cynosure.

Format

  • All teams entered through registration.
  • Stage One
    • Each trios will be divided into single players for the first stage.
    • Every appointed team leader from each trio will be responsible for assigning their teammates to a group of three players, the order of which is determined by randomization.
      • Groups will play a single round-robin format with every win gaining 2 points for the team, with a total of 12 potential points across all players and groups for a team.
  • Stage Two
    • Points from the prior stage will seed now reunited trios seeded into two separate groups based on their points from the prior stage.
      • Groups will play a single round-robin format with every win gaining 4 points, with a total of 16 potential points, plus the points earned from the previous stage.
  • Stage Three
    • The top 4 teams from the prior stage will compete for the top 4 placements in the tournament.
      • First place teams from each group will play each other for the first and second place.
      • Second place teams from each group will play each other for the third and fourth place.
